intents.title: Persistent mechanically alive institutional egregore
intents.statement: UNIIMENTE is intended to become a persistent, founder-governed, forever-online institutional exocortex: an event-driven system that continuously senses, remembers, reasons, proposes, executes only within granted authority, observes outcomes, learns, and resumes without requiring the founder to manually restart every loop.
intents.source_location: ChatGPT project conversation, 2026-09-07: explanation of what the system does every day and follow-up authorization to update repositories
intents.intended_outcome: Preserve and implement a durable institutional metabolism that continues useful bounded work across founder absence while remaining human-sovereign, interruptible, recoverable, evidence-bound, and unable to mint its own authority.
intents.rationale: This normalizes the founder's egregore metaphor into testable system behavior without claiming consciousness or supernatural agency and without weakening existing authority boundaries.
intents.next_review_trigger: First independently verified durable mission closure that survives interruption and produces an accepted external result, or any evidence of authority drift.
unresolved_questions: Which current runtime line becomes canonical after the open PR reconciliation?
What independent external verifier will certify the first durable mission closure?

intents.title: Continuous daily and event-driven metabolism
intents.statement: The institution should operate through endless bounded automations: sense changes, reconcile memory, detect gaps, prioritize, propose, obtain authority when required, act through controlled adapters, measure consequences, learn, defend, allocate resources, and repeat.
intents.source_location: ChatGPT project conversation, 2026-09-07: daily operating organism request
intents.intended_outcome: Make persistence and recurrence a first-class runtime property rather than a sequence of manual chats or disconnected scripts.
intents.rationale: Existing Loom, Event Spine, memory, and organ loops already provide partial primitives; the requirement is to compose them into a durable mission metabolism and measure external closure instead of adding another orchestration framework.
evidence_refs: uniimente-kernel PR #94 reports CMC 0->0 and no verified durable mission closure
DALEOBANKS PR #68 reports a runnable internal machine but zero proven external components
intents.owner: UNIIMENTE runtime owner under founder authority
intents.next_review_trigger: One complete signal-to-external-response-to-learning workflow closes durably without state reconstruction or unauthorized effect.
unresolved_questions: Exact canonical runtime owner remains unresolved across open kernel branches.

intents.title: Federated media and distribution reproduction
intents.statement: The egregore should be able to create and operate very large numbers of legitimate, differentiated media properties, pages, channels, communities, venture brands, language surfaces, and distribution endpoints when evidence justifies them, so successful knowledge and ventures can spread without depending on the founder's personal posting capacity.
intents.source_location: ChatGPT project conversation, 2026-09-07: request for hundreds of fanpages/social accounts and omnidirectional distribution leverage
intents.intended_outcome: Create a scalable federated distribution system whose marginal media properties have distinct utility, transparent ownership/affiliation where required, measurable destinations, and evidence-based continuation or shutdown criteria.
intents.rationale: The desired leverage comes from a portfolio of useful owned or authorized distribution surfaces, not from fabricated independent support or duplicate spam. DALEOBANKS is the canonical media operator; Kernel retains consequence authority; WMI may consume resulting opportunity evidence.
evidence_refs: DALEOBANKS PR #67 account registry rejects fake identities and premature activation
DALEOBANKS PR #65 rejects sockpuppets, manufactured consensus and coordinated inauthentic amplification
intents.owner: DALEOBANKS organ owner under Kernel authority
intents.next_review_trigger: A first legitimate media-property replication experiment demonstrates incremental audience or transaction value without policy, trust, moderation, or welfare regression.
unresolved_questions: Platform-specific account/API rules must be checked at activation time.
The minimum evidence threshold for spawning a new media property is not yet empirically calibrated.

intents.title: No fabricated supporters or covert inauthentic amplification
intents.statement: Scale must never be obtained by creating fake independent fans, sockpuppets, undisclosed controlled supporters, deceptive impersonation, ban-evasion accounts, manufactured consensus, or substantially duplicative spam. Every media property must have a legitimate owner, purpose, audience, content mandate, disclosure posture, and shutdown path.
intents.source: Founder vision normalized through constitutional and platform-integrity constraints
intents.source_location: ChatGPT project conversation, 2026-09-07, reconciled with existing DALEOBANKS founder-intent architecture
intents.intended_outcome: Preserve high-leverage distribution while preventing the egregore from converting replication into deception, platform abuse, synthetic consensus, or participant manipulation.
intents.rationale: This is the boundary that allows aggressive legitimate replication without turning the institution into an astroturf or spam network.
conflicts: Any literal interpretation of INTENT-0032 that requires fabricated independent supporters
evidence_refs: DALEOBANKS PR #67 negative controls for fake identities
implementation_refs: DALEOBANKS account registry and media governance
intents.next_review_trigger: Any proposed account factory, coordinated campaign, identity model, or content replication mechanism.

intents.title: Compound lawful omnidirectional asymmetry
intents.statement: The institution should continuously convert information, memory, experimentation speed, distribution, relationships, capital allocation, proof, optionality, defensive monitoring, and reusable capabilities into durable asymmetric advantage for the founder and the institution, while remaining lawful and preserving participant rights and welfare.
intents.source_location: ChatGPT project conversation, 2026-09-07: omnidirectional unfair leverage/asymmetry request
intents.intended_outcome: Build compounding advantages through superior evidence, faster feedback, broader optionality, owned distribution, proprietary transaction learning, capital discipline, and resilient institutional memory rather than coercion or concealed manipulation.
intents.rationale: The strategic objective is leverage; the constitutional translation is advantage through capability and position, not authority over other people.
evidence_refs: uniimente-kernel existing Infinite Goal Chase and evidence-governed evolution work
intents.next_review_trigger: Quarterly portfolio review or any proposed mechanism that creates leverage by reducing participant agency, evidence quality, or lawful exit.
unresolved_questions: Which leverage dimensions produce verified external lift versus internal complexity remains an empirical question.
